# Youth Legal Revolution

> This site provides legal education and civic information. It is not a substitute for advice from a qualified legal professional.

## Pages
- [Home](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/)
- [Organisational overview](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/overview.html)
- [Articles](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/articles.html)
- [Legislation and implementation reviews](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/research.html)
- [Contact](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/contact.html)
- [Terms](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/terms.html)
- [Privacy](https://youthlegalrevolution.in/privacy.html)

## Editorial approach
We explain rights and obligations in accessible language and link to primary sources. Research separates allegations from evidence and verified findings, records limitations and invites responses where appropriate.
